heading: A little help from Falc
localStatus: Local guided assistant · no AI provider
welcome: Hi, I’m Falc. Tell me about something you own or owe. I’ll prepare a record for you to review—nothing is saved without your confirmation.

examples.gold: I bought 20g of 22k gold for AED 5,000

messagePlaceholder: Tell me what you own or owe…
aiOptIn: Use AI mode: send this conversation to the configured AI provider. Optional; requires server setup.
safety: No trades. No bank access. No saving without confirmation.
reviewHelp: Draft only. Unknown values are not treated as zero. You can also type “{{saveCommand}}” in chat.

guide.advice: I can help record and explain your finances, but I cannot recommend what to buy or sell. Tell me about something you already own or owe.
guide.help: Tell me the kind of item: gold, cash, stocks, an IPO, crypto, a private investment, money lent, or a debt. For example: “I bought 20g of 22k gold for AED 5,000.” I only prepare a draft; you review and save it.
guide.missing: I have started a draft. Please add {{fields}}. You can reply here or edit the review card below. Nothing has been saved.
guide.ready: Your draft is ready to review below. Check the category, currency, amount, and date, then choose “Confirm and save”. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

fields.name: a name
fields.value: a current value (or mark it unknown)
fields.agreementType: whether this is ownership, a loan, or a gift

draftNotes: Prepared in guided chat. Confirm the details before saving.
goldNote: Value is your estimate, not a live gold quote. Jewellery making charges may not be recoverable.

messages.savedSession: Added for this session only. Browser storage could not save it. Download a backup from Reports before closing the page.
messages.saved: Saved in this browser. You can find it in Assets or Debts. Cloud saving is a separate, explicit action in Settings.
messages.sampleStart: This will replace this browser’s labelled sample picture with empty personal records. Your older portfolio remains preserved. To confirm, type “{{confirmStartCommand}}”. Your draft will stay here.
messages.alreadyPersonal: You are already using personal records. I will not clear them through chat.
messages.personalStarted: Your empty personal picture is ready. Review your draft, then type “{{saveCommand}}” when the details are right.
messages.summary: Your recorded assets: {{assets}}. Debts: {{debts}}. Estimated net worth: {{netWorth}}. {{qualification}} {{sampleNote}}
messages.incomplete: This is incomplete: some values or currency rates are missing.
messages.estimateOnly: These totals use the values you recorded, not guaranteed sale prices.
messages.sampleNote: You are viewing sample data, not your personal finances.
